description: ELIGIBILITY - Sliding::vf2 0x143f704f0 byte table at 0x143f70590. Stagger (0x10) maps to case 2 = refuse; case 1 asks the cancel gate. Lets a barged defender slide in off the stumble. More aggressive than the Tackle one - expect more fouls (the foul scorer is unchanged). Emulated: REFUSE -> GATED(vf14).

patches.name: Sliding::vf2 case table: currentKind Stagger -> ask the cancel gate
